nameEn: Manufacture of glass and glass products
description: This class includes the manufacture of glass in all its basic forms and glass products.
includes: manufacture of flat glass: float glass, plate glass, sheet glass
manufacture of toughened or laminated flat glass
manufacture of glass containers: bottles, jars, flasks, etc.
manufacture of glass fibres including glass wool and non-woven glass products
manufacture of domestic glassware: drinking glasses, bowls, vases, etc.
manufacture of glass for laboratory, hygienic or pharmaceutical use
manufacture of glass insulators and glass insulating fittings
manufacture of glass envelopes for lamps and cathode ray tubes
manufacture of glass wool and glass fibre
manufacture of clock or watch glasses, optical glass and optical elements
manufacture of glass paving blocks, bricks, tiles and other articles
excludes: manufacture of optical instruments and apparatus, see 2670
manufacture of artificial eyes of glass, see 3250
